scripts.lint: eslint . --no-cache --fix --max-warnings 0 --fix-type problem,suggestion,layout && echo '✅ ESLint: 所有问题已修复'
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --no-cache --fix && echo '✅ ESLint: 所有问题已修复'
scripts.stylelint: stylelint "app.vue" "assets/**/*.css" "components/**/*.vue" "layouts/**/*.vue" "pages/**/*.vue" --config ../frontend/stylelint.config.js --no-cache --fix && echo '✅ Stylelint: 所有问题已修复'
scripts.stylelint:fix: stylelint "app.vue" "assets/**/*.css" "components/**/*.vue" "layouts/**/*.vue" "pages/**/*.vue" --config ../frontend/stylelint.config.js --no-cache --fix && echo '✅ Stylelint: 所有问题已修复'
scripts.clean:lighthouse: rm -rf .lighthouseci/*.json .lighthouseci/*.html && echo '✅ Lighthouse 报告已清理'
